**Action Volume Tamer is now BoomGuard.** It's the same AI movie volume leveler for Firefox and Chrome, under a new name.

## Downloads
| Browser | File | How to install |
|---|---|---|
| **Firefox** (permanent) | `boomguard-firefox-2.2.0.xpi`, if listed below | Open the file in Firefox and click **Add**. Signed by Mozilla. |
| **Firefox** (try it out) | `boomguard-firefox-2.2.0.zip` | `about:debugging` → **This Firefox** → **Load Temporary Add-on…** → pick the zip. Lasts until Firefox restarts. |
| **Chrome / Edge / Brave** | `boomguard-chrome-2.2.0.zip` | Unzip → `chrome://extensions` → **Developer mode** → **Load unpacked** → pick the folder. |

## Upgrading from Action Volume Tamer
- **Firefox:** BoomGuard has a new add-on ID, so remove the old temporary add-on and load this one. What it learned starts fresh.
- **Chrome:** remove the old extension, then load the new folder.

## What it does
- Turns down **action** (explosions, gunfire, crashes, engines) toward dialogue level, and lifts **whispers**.
- Learns your taste from your volume changes, `Alt+Shift+↓/↑`, or the popup buttons.
- Runs two small AI models on your computer (Silero VAD and YAMNet). Nothing is sent anywhere.
